execution.ros_installation: version-pinned ROS 2 Jazzy deb packages; exact deb revisions and dependency closure must be captured before Stage 2 smoke
execution.compiler: capture exact compiler and C++ runtime before Stage 2 smoke
execution.host_policy: All five methods on one Linux host, same OS, CPU policy and measurement layer; Windows F0-05 latency is historical only
execution.worker: one persistent local worker per method (C++ MoveIt for external plugins, Python for DLS); identical newline-delimited IPC boundary; launch and warmup outside measured attempts
execution.timing: monotonic outer call through IPC, conversion, solver and independent validation; record solver-internal and IPC/adapter intervals separately when observable
execution.cpu_policy: one benchmark process at a time, same two-logical-CPU affinity set for all methods; record exact CPU IDs and governor before execution
execution.source_installation: fetch source at frozen commits into ignored external workspace; pin all deb revisions in environment lock before execution

queries.q_target_policy: offline query proof only; never sent to solver or worker

benchmark.warmup_policy: first 20 frozen queries per deadline, excluded from measurement
benchmark.validation: all finite candidates independently recomputed with Pinocchio CandidateValidator; solver success never substitutes for Profile A/B
benchmark.deadline_rule: independent geometry and total_elapsed_ns <= budget; late reply or validation fails deadline
benchmark.timeout_policy: pass remaining deadline to plugin; outer supervisor hard deadline; late worker result retained as TIMEOUT and validated if finite
benchmark.raw_results: all attempts including failures; if outside Git, record SHA-256, bytes, row count, command and storage state

adapter.boundary: Python benchmark contract to persistent local worker using one IPC protocol; no ROS service or remote network in measured path
adapter.pose_conversion: canonical wxyz to geometry_msgs xyzw at worker boundary; inverse conversion on readback; translation m and joint rad unchanged
adapter.joint_mapping: map by frozen joint names and reject missing, duplicate or reordered plugin joints
adapter.candidate_validation: independent Pinocchio FK on q_candidate, same robot/base/TCP and inclusive limits
adapter.result_schema: new C1-01 schema, versioned and separate from immutable DLS F0-05 schema; legacy F0-05 verification retained

solvers.name: DLS
solvers.integration: existing Python DLS in local worker under common adapter

solvers.name: KDL
solvers.internal_acceptance: KDL epsilon 1e-5 at pinned source; independent Profile A/B remains authoritative

solvers.name: TRAC-IK
solvers.internal_acceptance: TRAC-IK epsilon 1e-5 at pinned source; independent Profile A/B remains authoritative

solvers.name: pick_ik
solvers.internal_acceptance: 1 mm / 0.5 degree internal stopping; independently recheck A/B

solvers.name: pick_ik
solvers.seed: q_current; stochastic global search, seed hook to verify
solvers.internal_acceptance: 1 mm / 0.5 degree internal stopping; independently recheck A/B
